reason: Both pages load cleanly with no errors or overflow. A is the sturdier page to maintain. Its finder handles empty, out-of-range, empty-well, multi-match and reset states deliberately. It passes axe with zero violations, has a keyboard-complete menu and skip link, renders a static first paint without JS, and labels every example where it appears. B's search returns wrong results for trivial inputs and has no reset, and it has contrast failures and late example labelling. If B tightened its matching and moved its example label next to the result, the gap would mostly close.
